title: Commons Mind Drawer: live causal turn trace and click-message inspection

sections.what: Fix the Commons Mind drawer appearing behind chat replies by streaming live turn-step updates into CommonsState as each step executes, and allow clicking any character message in #commons-feed to inspect the exact causal trace (Notification -> Tools/Recall -> Intermediator Summary -> Inner Monologue -> Decision) that produced that message.
sections.why: Currently receiveMessage() posts the reply mid-loop while recordTurn() waits until after storeMemory() at the end of actCharacter(), making it look like characters reply before thinking. Clicking a message also only shows the character's latest turn rather than the flow that produced that specific message.
sections.how:
1. Add messageTraces (keyed by message_id), selectedDrawerMessageId, upsertLiveTurn(), and openDrawerForMessage() in static/js/commons/commons-state.ts.
2. Emit incremental step trace updates in static/js/commons/commons-agent.ts (notification trigger -> read_chat/recall -> recalled memories + intermediator summary -> inner monologue -> tool decision + posted message_id) before storeMemory().
3. Wire click-on-message in static/js/commons/commons-ui.ts to open the drawer for that message_id and render the ordered causal flow with a 'Latest' switch when viewing an older message.
4. Add JS unit tests in tools/unit/test_commons_agent.js covering live pre-reply trace emission and message_id trace binding.
sections.verify: Run npm run build:ts and node tools/unit/run.cjs test_commons_agent; verify in /commons that clicking a character message opens its ordered causal trace and live turns update the drawer before/as the reply lands.

acceptance.text: CommonsState receives live turn-step updates before/as send_chat posts to #commons-feed, never waiting for storeMemory() at turn end.
Clicking any character message in #commons-feed opens the Mind drawer focused on that message's exact causal flow (Notification, Tools, Recall, Intermediator Summary, Inner Monologue, Decision).
JS unit tests verify ordered trace steps and message_id trace lookup.

sections.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: /commons message feed (click any character message) -> Mind drawer ordered Causal Flow.

Manual verification steps:
1. Open http://localhost:4444/commons and trigger a character reply.
2. Click the character's message bubble in #commons-feed.
   - expected: Mind drawer opens showing the ordered causal flow for that message (Notification -> Tools/Recall -> Intermediator -> Inner Monologue -> Decision).
